name: Single Customer Credit Transfer
description: MT103 is used for single customer credit transfers. It is the most widely used SWIFT message for cross-border payments, instructing a financial institution to credit an account held with that institution. The message is sent by or on behalf of the ordering customer to the financial institution servicing the beneficiary customer.

block1.description: Basic Header - Contains application ID (F=FIN), service ID (01), sender BIC (12 chars), session number (4 digits), sequence number (6 digits)

block2.description: Application Header - Input format (I) or Output format (O). Contains message type (103), destination BIC (for input) or sender BIC (for output), priority (N=normal, U=urgent), and optional delivery monitoring

block3.description: User Header (optional) - Contains tag-value pairs like 108:MUR (message user reference), 121:UETR (unique end-to-end transaction reference), 119:STP or REMIT (straight through processing or remittance information)

block4.description: Text Block - Contains the actual message fields in tag-value format. Each field starts with :NN[a]: followed by the value. Multi-line values continue on the next line without tag prefix. Block ends with dash on new line.

block5.description: Trailer (optional) - Contains checksums and system information like CHK (checksum), TNG (training), PDE (possible duplicate emission), DLM (delayed message), MRF (message reference), PDM (possible duplicate message)

fields.name: Transaction Reference Number
fields.description: Unique reference assigned by the sender to unambiguously identify the message. SWIFT character set X.

fields.name: Time Indication
fields.description: Time at which the message was created. Format: /CLSTIME/HHMM+HHMM or /RNCTIME/HHMM+HHMM or /SNDTIME/HHMM+HHMM where HHMM is time and +HHMM is UTC offset.

subfields.name: Code
subfields.description: Time qualifier: CLSTIME=closing time, RNCTIME=reconciliation time, SNDTIME=send time

subfields.name: Offset
subfields.description: UTC offset in hours and minutes

fields.name: Bank Operation Code
fields.description: Code identifying the type of operation. Common codes: CRED (credit transfer), SPAY (salary payment), SPRI (priority payment), SSTD (standing order). SWIFT character set X.

fields.name: Instruction Code
fields.description: Instructions relating to the processing of the credit transfer. Can be repeated. Format: 4!c[/30x]. Common codes: CHQB (cheque book), HOLD (hold), INTC (intracompany), PHOB (phone beneficiary), PHOI (phone ordering institution), PHON (phone), TELB (phone beneficiary), TELE (phone), TELI (phone ordering institution).

fields.name: Transaction Type Code
fields.description: Specifies the type of transaction. 3-character alphanumeric code. Used for regulatory reporting and internal processing.

fields.name: Value Date, Currency Code, Amount
fields.description: Date on which the amount should be made available to the beneficiary, the currency code (ISO 4217), and the settlement amount. Format: 6!n3!a15d where 6!n is YYMMDD date, 3!a is currency code, 15d is amount with comma as decimal separator.

subfields.name: Value Date
subfields.description: Date on which the transfer should be executed

subfields.name: Currency Code
subfields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

subfields.name: Amount
subfields.description: Settlement amount with comma as decimal separator (e.g., 1234567,89)

fields.name: Currency/Instructed Amount
fields.description: Currency and amount instructed. Used when the instructed amount differs from the settlement amount (e.g., currency conversion). Format: 3!a15d.

subfields.name: Amount
subfields.description: Instructed amount with comma as decimal separator

fields.name: Exchange Rate
fields.description: Exchange rate used for currency conversion. Format: 12d with comma as decimal separator.

fields.name: Ordering Customer - Account/BIC
fields.description: Ordering customer identified by account number and BIC. Optional account line, then BIC on next line. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Ordering Customer - Structured
fields.description: Ordering customer with structured party identifier. Multiple numbered lines (1-4): 1/Account, 2/Name&Address (up to 4x35), 3/Country&Town, 4/Date of birth. Format varies by line number.

fields.name: Ordering Customer - Name & Address
fields.description: Ordering customer identified by account and name/address. Optional account line, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters for name and address. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for customer name and address

fields.name: Sending Institution
fields.description: Institution that is sending the message. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Ordering Institution - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution which orders the transfer on behalf of the ordering customer. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Ordering Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Ordering institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

fields.name: Sender's Correspondent - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution through which the sender will reimburse. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Sender's Correspondent - Location
fields.description: Sender's correspondent identified by party identifier and location. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 35x

fields.name: Sender's Correspondent - Name & Address
fields.description: Sender's correspondent identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

fields.name: Receiver's Correspondent - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution through which the receiver will reimburse. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Receiver's Correspondent - Location
fields.description: Receiver's correspondent identified by party identifier and location. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 35x

fields.name: Receiver's Correspondent - Name & Address
fields.description: Receiver's correspondent identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

fields.name: Third Reimbursement Institution - BIC
fields.description: Third institution involved in the reimbursement. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Third Reimbursement Institution - Location
fields.description: Third reimbursement institution identified by party identifier and location. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 35x

fields.name: Third Reimbursement Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Third reimbursement institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

fields.name: Intermediary Institution - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution between the ordering and beneficiary institutions. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Intermediary Institution - Location
fields.description: Intermediary institution identified by party identifier only. Format: /34x

fields.name: Intermediary Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Intermediary institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

fields.name: Account With Institution - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution servicing the beneficiary customer account. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Account With Institution - Location
fields.description: Account with institution identified by party identifier and location. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 35x

fields.name: Account With Institution - Party Identifier
fields.description: Account with institution identified by party identifier only. Format: /34x

fields.name: Account With Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Account with institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

fields.name: Beneficiary Customer
fields.description: Customer receiving the funds. Optional account line, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters for name and address. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Account
subfields.description: Optional account number or IBAN prefixed with /

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for beneficiary name and address

fields.name: Beneficiary Customer - Account/BIC
fields.description: Beneficiary customer identified by account and BIC. Optional account line, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Beneficiary Customer - Structured
fields.description: Beneficiary customer with structured party identifier. Multiple numbered lines (1-4): 1/Account, 2/Name&Address (up to 4x35), 3/Country&Town, 4/Date of birth. Format varies by line number.

fields.name: Remittance Information
fields.description: Information sent to the beneficiary. Up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Used for invoice numbers, reference information, payment purpose. Format: 4*35x

fields.name: Details of Charges
fields.description: Specifies which party bears the charges. BEN = beneficiary pays all charges (not allowed in SEPA), OUR = ordering customer pays all charges, SHA = charges are shared (SEPA requires SHA).

fields.name: Sender's Charges
fields.description: Charges taken by the sender. Can appear multiple times. Format: 3!a15d (currency code + amount with comma as decimal separator).

subfields.name: Amount
subfields.description: Charge amount with comma as decimal separator

fields.name: Receiver's Charges
fields.description: Charges taken by the receiver. Format: 3!a15d (currency code + amount with comma as decimal separator).

subfields.name: Amount
subfields.description: Charge amount with comma as decimal separator

fields.name: Sender to Receiver Information
fields.description: Additional information for the receiver. Up to 6 lines of 35 characters. Used for regulatory info, special instructions, additional references. Format: 6*35x

fields.name: Regulatory Reporting
fields.description: Information for regulatory reporting. Up to 3 lines of 35 characters. Required for certain jurisdictions and transaction types. Format: 3*35x

field_ordering.description: MT103 field ordering rules. Mandatory fields must appear in specific order. Optional fields have positioning constraints relative to mandatory fields and each other. One of field 50 options (A/F/K) must be present. Either field 59, 59A, or 59F must be present.

optional_sequences.notes: Time indication appears between transaction reference and bank operation code
Instruction code can appear multiple times
Transaction type code before value date/amount
Instructed amount appears after settlement amount
Exchange rate follows instructed amount if present
Ordering customer - exactly one option (A/F/K) should be present
Sending institution between ordering customer and ordering institution
Ordering institution - use one option (A or D)
Third reimbursement institution - use one option (A/B/D)
Account with institution - use one option (A/B/C/D)
Beneficiary customer - exactly one option (no suffix/A/F) must be present
Sender's charges - can appear multiple times
Regulatory reporting appears last if present
